purpose: Explain deterministic, observational clusters of a selected vehicle's bounded recent drive history, including eligibility, coverage, model selection, assignments and interpretation limits.
primaryGoal: Understand distinct observed driving patterns and judge whether their source coverage, imputation and geometric separation justify interpretation, without treating clusters as verified trip purposes.

dataSources.ownership: Existing driving hook and backend drive handler; no archetype-specific backend endpoint.
dataSources.behavior: Limit clamped to 1..1000; dedicated history query key; vehicle enablement; request receives AbortSignal; MODERATE stale policy; safeArray selection. Server filtering, ordering and returned field values were not exercised.

dataSources.ownership: Existing workspace vehicle selection and timezone policy.
dataSources.behavior: No competing local vehicle or date picker. /drive-archetypes is absent from RANGE_ENABLED_PATHS in web\src\lib\workspaceScope.ts:23-77; current scope is explicitly newest bounded history, not a header-selected date range. Do not silently introduce a date restriction during cosmetic modernization.

dataSources.ownership: Feature-owned pure analytical model; memoized by page at lines 42-45.
dataSources.behavior: Raw SI distanceM, avgSpeedMps, energyUsedWh, durationS, outsideTempAvgC and source addresses/startTs. One terminal source disposition per row, valid unique positive IDs, valid starts, distance >=500m, positive energy and speed. Temperature median imputation, or 15 C configured default, remains explicitly imputed. Six standardized dimensions: log distance, speed, circular-hour sine/cosine, Wh/m and temperature. Minimum 20 eligible drives; k=2..5; deterministic seed 0x5eed; bounded silhouette sample 400; four restarts; realized-cluster gate; raw silhouette maximum with smaller-k exact tie-break. Directory cap 80; full assignments and identities are retained.

dataSources.ownership: Existing unit, locale, date and shared metric presentation owners.
dataSources.behavior: Physical conversions only in display projections and formatters; null/nonfinite efficiency returns an em dash; date formatting uses saved locale and vehicle timezone. Briefs retain numeric counts, silhouette and span seconds as rawValue. Exported chart projections use disclosed display units, not a replacement SI cache.

issues.detail: requirement='eligible' checks analyzedDrives===0, but otherwise falls through to insufficient_drives/variation/partition gating. Feature ranges and imputation are therefore withheld even with 1-19 eligible drives, although summarizeArchetypes retains normalization evidence. Source-confirmed gate mismatch, not runtime-reproduced.
issues.fix: Separate eligible-only evidence eligibility from partition eligibility. Keep the truthful clustering-withheld notice while showing available eligible ranges/imputation; add scoped cases for 1-19 drives and constant features.

issues.detail: Candidate section uses default clustered requirement. summarizeArchetypes:1074-1081 retains candidate evaluations when no candidate realizes every cluster, but SectionBody:98-104 hides them behind the insufficient_partition message. The diagnostic model evidence is available but not presented in that state.
issues.fix: Introduce an explicit candidate-evidence requirement within this domain owner, distinguishing candidate evaluations from published partition data; retain unrealized decisions and withholding caveat.

visualIssues.detail: Six charts use fixed stroke-white/10 grid decoration (candidate:105, composition:104, confidence:95, hourly:90, monthly:98). This is a theme-invariant white reference color, not pure-white body text; light/custom-theme composition is unverified.
visualIssues.fix: Reuse canonical theme-aware chart grid stroke token; preserve axes, data series, labels and user-selected palettes.

visualIssues.detail: Selected row uses literal bg-cyan-500/5 rather than a semantic selection token. Low opacity is not neon escalation but fixes hue independently of theme; selected text and badge already convey the decision.
visualIssues.fix: Use existing subtle semantic selection treatment, preserving the explicit Selected text and success badge.

architectureIssues.detail: deriveDataState receives a Boolean presence surrogate plus errors/fetch status, but no original dataUpdatedAt or age threshold. It can represent refresh-failed/offline retained evidence, not age-based freshness. Mounted coverage/source briefs label returned counts/window bounds, not last successful fetch time.
architectureIssues.fix: Carry original query last-success metadata through the existing ArchetypeQueryState and DataState contract if freshness is exposed; avoid inventing timestamps or claiming live/current evidence.

priority.rationale: Already largely shared-component/token-based and unusually complete about observational trust. Prioritize partition-versus-eligible gating and diagnostic candidate visibility, then theme-neutral grid noise and mounted mobile/keyboard verification. No evidence warrants rewriting the analytical engine.
priority.visualNoiseAssessment: Scoped search found six fixed-white grid references and one fixed cyan selection reference; no direct neon/glow/shadow/text-white body references, raw interactive HTML, static style= or direct chart/map/motion library imports in the inspected page/feature JSX scope. Shared CHART_COLORS supplies all six charts; saturation of actual saved palettes was not measured and must not be reset. No runtime appearance acceptance.

requiredSharedChanges.propsVariantsStates: Reuse DataState.updatedAt/ageMs and deriveDataState source dataUpdatedAt; preserve fatalError versus refreshError, retry and blocked refresh. Domain query state must carry actual last-success metadata before displaying freshness.

requiredSharedChanges.changeNeeded: First verify existing shared behavior; local grid-token adoption is supported by source. Shared motion extension only if canonical behavior is missing; not established as a new-component requirement.

competingImplementations.detail: Mounted briefs are aliased as ArchetypeEvidenceLedger/SourceDisposition/HistoryCoverage. Same-named older presentation files remain in drive-archetypes; scoped source search shows LayoutCard/stat-based implementations there, but this page imports the OperationalBrief versions directly.
competingImplementations.decision: Audit the mounted brief path, not names in the barrel. Treat older alternatives as a possible competing presentation owner; callers elsewhere and deletion safety were not traced. Do not delete them or transfer historical acceptance.
